svg.aria-label: A deadline requirement fails on a recorded trace, and the engineer asks why. The engineer sends F[0,3] p2 to tl-parse and gets a formula document, binds p2 to signal s2 with tl-syntax, and sends the document to tl-rewrite, which reports Unchanged. tl-mltl evaluates the formula and trace and returns false at time 0 with a buffer of 4 instants, and R2U2, which runs outside the crates, returns false at time 0 for the C2PO expression F[0,3](p2). tl-oracle evaluates the same formula and trace independently and returns false. quire-mltl maps the result to Value false. Numbered rings mark where to look at each step.
